_meta.title: Master restricted-products reference — all 30 categories, deep detail
_meta.purpose: The comprehensive reference: every Amazon restricted category with status, required docs, trigger keywords, prohibited substances, and marketplace-specific notes. Danger zones (batteries, medical, radio, cosmetics, supplements, hazmat, children's) in full depth; all others at solid category level. Consolidates tier1 + tier2 + tier2b + deep research.
_meta.confidence_note: Compiled from Amazon published policy + regulators (FDA, EPA, FCC, Ofcom, CPSC, MHRA, HSE) + industry compliance references, accurate as of compile date. Amazon updates without notice. Definitive per-ASIN/per-account answer = Seller Central Apply-to-Sell.
_meta.usage_rule: SOURCING ALARM + listing warning. PROHIBITED -> block normal submit (logged force-list only). GATED -> warn + show docs, submit allowed. Never a copy tool: never strip a true spec/ingredient to conceal a restricted product (account-ending).
_meta.marketplace_principle: EU/UK is generally the stricter constraint (esp. cosmetics, children's). Several restrictions are marketplace-specific and must resolve per active marketplace, never globally. Hazmat and category approvals are per-marketplace — approval in one region does NOT carry to another.

categories.label: Dietary supplements
prohibited_ingredients: Ephedra / ephedrine alkaloids (incl. Sida cordifolia / heartleaf sida — Amazon treats plant-sourced ephedrine as prohibited)
hidden pharmaceuticals (sildenafil, tadalafil — common in sexual-enhancement products)
docs: Certificate of Analysis from ISO/IEC 17025-certified lab
amazon_specific_rules: EVERY ingredient claim on the detail page must MATCH the Supplement Facts Panel in name, weight, presentation — 'label-led not marketing-led'. Deactivations for mismatched legacy copy from 2026-03-31.
No 'equivalent raw material' / potency storytelling that exceeds the panel.
Sexual-enhancement & weight-loss supplements CANNOT be sold in single- or double-pill packs (since 2021-12-06).
categories.claims_trap: Any disease claim (diagnose/cure/mitigate/treat/prevent) = unapproved drug = instant restriction.

categories.label: Cosmetics / skincare / topicals
prohibited_ingredients_us: Mercury compounds (aliases: Hg, mercuric iodide, mercurous chloride, ammoniated mercury, quicksilver, cinnabaris, hydrargyri oxydum rubrum)
amazon_specific_rules: Separate SKIN-LIGHTENER/whitening policy: requires third-party GMP, heavy-metals + mercury testing, FDA forms 5066 (facility) + 5067 (product). NSF is a named approved tester.
Topicals (anything applied to skin, incl. oils) require approval.
docs: UK/EU: CPSR (signed by qualified assessor) + SCPN(UK)/CPNP(EU) + INCI labelling + Responsible Person
US: FDA registration, GMP, COA, manufacturer invoice (last 180 days)

categories.label: Medical devices & accessories
categories.detail: Nebulizers/inhalers = Class II, 510(k), prescription-only, Amazon Professional Healthcare Program only (near-closed for resellers). TENS, blood-pressure monitors, some massagers = Class II OTC. Over-triggers from keywords (beauty/back-strap/snore-guard items get flagged).
docs: US: FDA 510(k) clearance + establishment registration + manufacturer invoice + packaging photos + IFU; prescription devices need Professional Healthcare Program
UK/EU: UKCA(GB)/CE mark + signed Declaration of Conformity under MDR

categories.label: Lithium batteries & products containing them
thresholds: >100Wh: prohibited from standard FBA without special approval
Wh rating MUST match across marketplaces or flagged
categories.scope_trap: Anything with a lithium cell: toothbrushes, speakers, earbuds, toy cars, tools, flashlights. 'If it charges, it's affected.'

categories.label: Radio / wireless / FPV transmitting equipment

marketplaces.UK: 5.8GHz >25mW EIRP = PROHIBITED (Ofcom IR2030); 2.4GHz control >100mW prohibited. Jammers prohibited.
marketplaces.US: 5.8GHz up to 1W legal (FCC Part 15); jammers prohibited; FCC ID/certification required.

categories.detail: High-power FPV VTX is the classic marketplace-split case: 600mW prohibited UK / legal US. Signal jammers prohibited both. Surveillance/hidden-camera restricted.

categories.label: Hazmat / dangerous goods (9 classes)
fba_outcomes: Restricted-dangerous: FBA only if enrolled in Dangerous Goods Program (special centers, higher fees)
Unfulfillable: Class 1 explosives, Class 7 radioactive, Class 6.2 infectious — cannot enter FBA at all
classes: Class 2 (aerosols — every aerosol qualifies due to propellant)
Class 3 flammable liquids (flash point <=60C/140F: perfume, nail polish, lighter fluid, lamp oil)
categories.scope_trap: Aerosols, perfume, nail polish, hand sanitizer, glycolic-acid skincare, magnets (speakers/toys), glue/adhesives, disinfectants all trigger it.
categories.note: Approval is MARKETPLACE-SPECIFIC. Review takes ~4 business days to 2-3 weeks. Certain words in the listing trigger it.

categories.label: Children's products / toys (<=12 yrs)
docs_us: Children's Product Certificate (CPC) based on CPSC-accepted third-party lab testing
docs_uk_eu: BS EN 71 / EN 71 (71-1 mechanical, 71-2 flammability, 71-3 toxic elements)
categories.scope: Toys, apparel, jewelry, books, art materials, children's furniture — anything for kids <=12. Amazon usually gives ~30 days to provide CPC; non-compliance = removal even after years listed.

categories.label: Composite wood products

marketplaces.US: Prohibited unless EPA TSCA Title VI / CARB formaldehyde compliant

docs: EPA TSCA Title VI / CARB Phase 2 formaldehyde certification
categories.note: Plywood, MDF, particleboard. Also hits children's toys with composite panels.

marketplaces.US: Clothing storage units require DV Direct Verification per ASTM F2057-23 (anti-tip/stability)

categories.label: Pesticides & pesticide-claim products
categories.claims_trap: NON-pesticide products pulled in by pesticide-CLAIM language (kill/sanitize/antimicrobial/mold-resistant) — the Mil-Gear case.

categories.label: Opaque / light-blocking goggles & eyeshields
categories.note: Attribute-triggered: see-through eyewear is fine.

categories.label: CBD / hemp / cannabis
categories.note: Largely restricted/prohibited; verify — often no path. Per-marketplace US/UK legal lines to be researched by owner.

categories.label: Weapons, firearms, ammunition, certain knives
categories.note: UK knife laws stricter than US; automatic/concealed knives prohibited. Exact UK knife-law list + what's allowed to be researched by owner.

categories.label: Laser products / pointers

marketplaces.US: Limited to Class 3R (<=5mW), must be branded. Class 3B & Class 4 barred. Handheld pointers generally not allowed.
marketplaces.UK: Consumer products restricted to Class 1 or Class 2 (stricter). OPSS has removed Class 3/4 lasers from Amazon UK.

thresholds: UK: Class 1 or 2 only for consumers
docs: US: FDA accession number + testing report from Intertek/UL/SGS + brand
list of laser ASINs + seller info

categories.label: Lock picking & theft devices
categories.note: Prohibited: lock-pick sets, slim-jims, tension bars, key-duplication devices, Sensormatic detachers, card-skimming devices, code grabbers, shoplifting/booster devices. ALLOWED: blank keys only.

categories.label: Surveillance / spy equipment
categories.note: PROHIBITED: covert/eavesdropping devices, devices to intercept conversations, signal jammers. ALLOWED: baby monitors, non-eavesdropping security cameras.

categories.label: Food, beverages, grocery
requirements: Expiration date PERMANENTLY marked on every unit (set is_expiration_dated_product=true in inventory template)
Sesame must be declared (9th US allergen, FASTER Act 2023)
FDA RACC serving sizes (21 CFR 101.12) mandatory — foreign serving sizes void the Nutrition Facts panel (#1 import error)
FSVP program if importer of record (FDA can demand records in 24h)
English labelling: name, net weight, ingredients, allergens, nutrition, manufacturer

categories.label: Jewelry & precious gems
categories.note: Fine jewelry gated for anti-fraud/quality. Requires establishing account history.

categories.label: Refrigerants / ozone-depleting substances

marketplaces.US: Can ONLY be sold to EPA Section 608/609 certified technicians (40 CFR 82 Subpart F, Clean Air Act). Effectively closed to general buyers.

categories.exception: Small cans of R-134a substitute for motor-vehicle AC.

categories.label: Automotive & powersports
categories.note: Top-level open, but: EMISSIONS DEFEAT DEVICES prohibited (Title II Clean Air Act) — tuners/deletes removed even WITH CARB EO docs. Tires/wheels/rims = separate gate. Parts needing EPA Certificate of Conformity gated. Products must retain full OBD/emissions functionality.

categories.label: Fine art
categories.note: No mass-produced/unnamed-artist works.

categories.label: Collectible coins & currency
categories.note: No altered/counterfeit legal tender.

categories.label: Animals & animal products
categories.note: No live pets/endangered fur/feathers/marine mammals.

categories.label: Plant & seed products
categories.note: Phytosanitary specifics + prohibited-species list to be researched by owner.

categories.label: Recalled products
categories.note: Amazon ingests CPSC/FDA recall feeds automatically.

categories.label: Lighting products (bulbs, lamps)
categories.note: Must meet energy-efficiency standards; non-compliant bulbs/lamps prohibited. Exact DOE standard + required docs to be researched by owner.

categories.label: Electronics recycling / e-waste
categories.note: Recycling-electronics program restrictions apply.

categories.label: Postage meters & stamps
categories.note: Collectible stamps allowed; counterfeit stamps & unauthorized postage-meter equipment prohibited.

categories.label: Offensive & controversial materials
categories.note: Hate symbols, items promoting violence/intolerance, culturally insensitive content prohibited.

categories.label: Strike-anywhere matches
categories.note: Fire hazard — prohibited (safety matches may differ; verify).

categories.label: Ozone/UV CPAP cleaning devices
categories.note: Devices claiming to clean CPAPs with ozone gas or UV light are FDA-unapproved and prohibited.

categories.label: Washington State expanded polystyrene
categories.note: State-specific restriction (US).

cross_cutting.claims_to_regulated_conversion: Three categories flip via COPY not product: supplement disease-claims -> drug; cosmetic anti-acne/SPF/antibacterial -> drug; any product kill/sanitize/antimicrobial -> pesticide. These overlap the claims screener.
cross_cutting.keyword_over_triggering: Amazon's automated classifiers over-trigger from title/bullet/review keywords (medical-device, pesticide, hazmat). A clean product with the wrong word gets pulled into a restricted bucket.
cross_cutting.no_match_not_safe: Absence from this list is NOT a clearance. Subcategory gating and account-specific gating only resolve via Seller Central Apply-to-Sell.
cross_cutting.enforcement_timing: Often post-listing: created fine, removed/flagged weeks later. Notice windows typically 14-30 days to provide docs.
still_needed_from_login: Amazon's verbatim per-category sub-page text (G200164330 children)
account-specific gating status per account (Apple/Nike-style brand gating)
